items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Walter P. Thomas) only confirms the presence of Keg Johnson in the band ('Right.') when asked by the interviewer. The interviewer identifies Keg Johnson as a 'dear friend of mine' and mentions him as a trombone player in the group, but the interviewee provides no personal interactio

ctx.x: Yeah, and we needed a bass player.

Keg Johnson, who was a dear friend of mine, recommended me, and sent Cab down to hear me at the Three Deuces. Then Cab came and heard me with Zuttie Singleton and Art Tatum and Lee Collins and Eddie Barksdale...
